purpose: Causal-feature cross-method prediction adequacy screen, not certified physical identification
data: Two complete2001-row10ms diagnostics, unchanged S3R2 and ordinaryBLNN
coordinates: mean position and half right-minus-left displacement, both in metres
features: Past encoder-derived velocities, instantaneous signed motorRPM-derived velocities, observed current or attempted command at0/10/20/30ms lag, measured skew, smooth friction-direction features; no future feature values
fit: Standardized ridge, fixedlambda0.001, no hyperparameter search. Target is next10ms encoder velocity. Train one controller and evaluate the other, then reverse.
scores: Both coordinates and inferred axis positions, full motion4..20s and moving stages separately; retained prediction errors and design matrix conditioning
interpretation: Predictive gains cannot identify unique physical mass/friction, recover all1ms dynamics, or establish counterfactual closed-loop efficacy. Full-trajectory forced rollout has recorded inputs but no measured-state resets; poor rollout prevents treating one-step accuracy as a validated plant.
